title: Update Export screen with Backup/Restore UI
description: Refactor the Export screen to present three distinct action cards: Export PDF (existing), Backup, and Restore Backup. The Restore card shows an irreversibility warning and requires an Alert confirmation before executing.
steps: Import useBackupRestore from '@/hooks/use-backup-restore' and Alert from react-native
Replace the single centered layout with a ScrollView containing three section cards (use View with className='mb-4 rounded-xl bg-card p-4 border border-border')
Card 1 — 'Exportar PDF': move existing createPDF logic and button here; add a short description text above the button ('Exporta todos os mapas da congregação em formato PDF')

Card 2 — 'Backup': description text ('Salva todas as cidades e mapas em um arquivo .json que pode ser restaurado posteriormente'); Backup button calls createBackup(); show ActivityIndicator + progress text while loading

Card 3 — 'Restaurar Backup': warning text in danger color ('Atenção: esta ação não pode ser desfeita. Todos os dados atuais serão substituídos pelo backup.'); Restore button calls Alert.alert with title 'Confirmar restauração', message 'Todos os mapas e cidades serão apagados e substituídos pelos dados do backup. Deseja continuar?', buttons Cancel and Confirmar (calls restoreBackup()); show ActivityIndicator + progress text while loading
If error from useBackupRestore is set, show a Text in danger color below the relevant card
acceptanceCriteria: Export PDF card works exactly as before
Backup button generates and shares a .json file
Restore button shows Alert confirmation before proceeding
Restore card displays irreversibility warning in danger color
Loading indicator and progress text are visible during backup and restore operations
Error messages are displayed when backup or restore fails
